matrix.domain_and_pair_order: Formal Conjectures defines S on ℕ × ℕ by n < m and equal primeFactors. The external PairSet is definitionally the same predicate on ℕ × ℕ with z.1 < z.2. Its witnesses are familyPair x = (n x, n x + 1), hence satisfy the required strict order. The consecutive-pair family is a stronger witness restriction, not a different target predicate.
matrix.central_binomial_definition: Both statements use Nat.centralBinom. In the external Mathlib source it is defined as (2 * n).choose n, exactly the central binomial coefficient intended by Formal Conjectures.
matrix.prime_support_equality: Both predicates compare Nat.centralBinom.primeFactors by Finset equality. Mathlib defines Nat.primeFactors as primeFactorsList.toFinset, so this is equality of prime-divisor support, ignoring multiplicity. No surrogate support predicate occurs at the terminal bridge.
matrix.conclusion_strength: The terminal theorem proves FullDensityCore.PairSet.Infinite unconditionally. It obtains infinitely many injectively mapped consecutive pairs, which is stronger in witness-family form and directly entails infinitude of the unrestricted Formal Conjectures S. Thus it supports the retained mathematical proposition S.Infinite. It does not directly prove the Formal Conjectures declaration erdos_730, whose answer(sorry) parameter and proof are placeholders.
matrix.proof_assumptions_and_axioms: Across all 74 ErdosProblems/Erdos730*.lean modules, a source scan excluding comments found no sorry, admit, axiom, opaque, or unsafe. Both terminal declarations audit to exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], standard Lean/Mathlib axioms. FormalConjectures/ErdosProblems/730.lean contains two executable sorry occurrences: one supplies answer(sorry), and one proves the answer equivalence; these are retained Formal Conjectures placeholders, not escapes in the external proof corpus.
matrix.toolchain_and_import_boundary: The external proof compiles at Lean 4.29.1 with Mathlib 5e932f97dd25535344f80f9dd8da3aab83df0fe6. Formal Conjectures is pinned to Lean 4.27.0 with Mathlib a3a10db0e9d66acbebf76c5e6a135066525ac900. Therefore this is semantic source equivalence across repositories, not a direct cross-repository Lean proof or a checked port of the Formal Conjectures declaration.
